pattern: ぶる / ぶって / ぶった
purpose: Present someone as putting on an attitude or identity.
keywords: N / adjective stem + ぶる; ぶった + N
He began explaining as if he were an expert.
I find people who put on airs hard to deal with.
My little brother says things to sound grown-up.
formation: N / adjective stem + ぶる; ぶった + N
restrictions: Common with 偉い, 大人, 専門家.
mistake: Unlike びる, ぶる often suggests deliberate pretence.
